The two partial cases now have source-bound replacement and exposure estimates. Official EA Madden NFL 27 ratings also resolve the previously missing Mason Richman and Levelle Bailey historical baselines to zero points under the frozen non-QB curve without rewriting the registry. priorEvidenceBinding.rationale: Reuses the verified final, frozen kickoff ratings and H4, exact 3,907-second duration, final gamebook participation, quarterback/specialist coverage, literal injury sequence and zero-calibrated Badie/Arroyo cases. This additive record resolves only the Waddle/Elliss replacement-exposure inputs and records newly discovered reserve-list blockers.

sources.finding: The official gamebook binds a 3,907-second overtime game; Waddle's last confirmed pre-absence target, later questionable status and explicit Q3 8:30 return; Elliss's participation and out-of-game status at the start of overtime; and the final participants and inactive/DNP inventories.

Denver's official September 22 depth chart lists Lil'Jordan Humphrey directly behind Jaylen Waddle and Dondrea Tillman directly behind Jonah Elliss. Humphrey and Tillman are both listed as game participants in the final gamebook. The historical estimate allocates only the additional vacant duty and preserves their independent baseline duties.

Denver's official roster lists Levelle Bailey, Pat Bryant, Jonah Coleman, Michael Deiter and Matt Henningsen on reserve/injured and Frank Crum and Caleb Lohner on reserve/injured designated for return. The final gamebook contains none as participants, inactives or DNPs.

Denver's official transaction log records Jonah Coleman placed on injured reserve September 26 and Pat Bryant placed on injured reserve October 9 while Lil'Jordan Humphrey was promoted to the active roster.

Seattle's official roster lists Jake Bobo, Anthony Bradford, Bud Clark, Julian Neal, Robbie Ouzts, Jadarian Price and Mason Richman on reserve/injured and Zach Charbonnet on reserve/PUP. The final gamebook contains none as participants, inactives or DNPs.

Seattle's October 16 postgame update confirms Bradford and Price remained on injured reserve and Charbonnet had not been activated from PUP for the Denver game. It also confirms Arroyo was undergoing testing after the shoulder injury; no return is implied.

EA's official Madden NFL 27 player page identifies Mason Richman, RT, at OVR 63. The unchanged frozen non-QB curve converts OVR 63 to 0.0 Walters points. This is a source-bound historical estimate only and does not amend the frozen player-value registry.

EA's official Madden NFL 27 weak-backer ratings page identifies Levelle Bailey, WILL, at OVR 63. The unchanged frozen non-QB curve converts OVR 63 to 0.0 Walters points using the governed LB band. This is a source-bound historical estimate only and does not amend the frozen player-value registry.
